root_cause.text: The BR_BOOLOPT_FDB_LOCAL_VLAN_0 toggle unconditionally calls VLAN group iteration functions without checking if the VLAN group pointer is NULL, which occurs when CONFIG_BRIDGE_VLAN_FILTERING is disabled.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message and CVE description state: "When CONFIG_BRIDGE_VLAN_FILTERING is not set, br_vlan_group() and nbp_vlan_group() return NULL ... The BR_BOOLOPT_FDB_LOCAL_VLAN_0 toggle code is compiled unconditionally and reaches br_fdb_delete_locals_per_vlan_port() and br_fdb_insert_locals_per_vlan_port(), where the NULL vlan group pointer is dereferenced via list_for_each_entry(v, &vg->vlan_list, vlist)." The patch adds `if (!vg) return;` and `if (!vg) return 0;` checks in both functions.
